scripts.build: cd rust-wasm && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/mdit_rs_wasm.wasm && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > pkg/package.json && cd ../native && cargo build --release
scripts.build:mdust: cd .. && cargo build --release -p mdust-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir crates/mdust-wasm/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/mdust_wasm.wasm && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > crates/mdust-wasm/pkg/package.json
